walkthroughs.body_html:
Financial Information and Decisions — a core area of GCSE Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Financial Information and Decisions brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Financial Information and Decisions.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Schumpeter described entrepreneurs as agents of:
options: Marginal utility
Creative destruction
Comparative advantage
Perfect competition

mcqs.q: Roughly what percentage of UK start-ups fail within three years?
What three Ps are added to make the extended marketing mix (7Ps)?
options: The 7Ps are just the 4Ps repeated with different words.
People (staff/service quality), Process (how the service is delivered), and Physical Evidence (tangible cues — uniforms, packaging, branding) — added to make the 4Ps relevant to services marketing.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.
Primary research is done first and secondary research is done later.

mcqs.q: What does Maslow's hierarchy of needs propose about motivation?
options: Maslow said money is the most important motivator at work.
Humans are motivated by a hierarchy of needs (physiological, safety, social, esteem, self-actualisation) — lower needs must be substantially met before higher ones motivate.
Primary research is done first and secondary research is done later.
Maslow said employees must be promoted every year.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between primary and secondary market research?
options: Primary research is the most important and secondary research is less important.
Primary research is original data the business gathers itself (surveys, interviews); secondary research uses existing data (reports, government statistics, market intelligence).
Primary research is done first and secondary research is done later.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.
